qal.sense_hint: simple (only biblical occurrence is a construct-state participle, not a free citation form -- shown here as an explicit exception to the absolute-state-only participle rule, since no other attestation exists)

notes: This root's sole biblical occurrence (Isa.47.13, הֹבְרֵי שָׁמַיִם, "the dividers of heaven" i.e. astrologers) is a construct-state participle -- normally excluded by the absolute-state-only participle rule -- kept anyway as an explicit exception (precedent: H2904, H6140, H3960, H7710, H1110) since no absolute-state attestation exists at all. The word also has a ketiv spelling (הברו, a perfect 3cp) at the same verse position, but it shares this same Strong's number as the qere, so per strip_redundant_ketivs it's a spelling variant, not a second attestation.
